title: Bitterness Is A Nasty Theme For A Stage Play; Hardsell True To Its Name; Madness

contact_edits.before: There's plenty of video here, too, most effectively at the end when images of the square after the tanks went in have us retrospectively putting faces to the carnage. For that much, I guess, you have to give the play credit. But it remains a hopelessly naive attempt at a tragic subject, like children's theatre on a bad day. - Hardsell plays through May 9 at the Berkeley Street Theatre. Call 416-368-3110 for ticket information; The Madness of the Square plays through May 3 at the Factory Theatre. Call 416-504-9971 for details.
